en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1930 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about a man who converted to Islam in the middle of the Month of Ramadan: What is required of him in terms of fasting?
Imam (as) said: "He is only required to fast the days remaining from when he became Muslim, and he is not obligated to make up the days that have already passed."
